facts.text: Clear the evil out of the Barrow Mound for the Free Goblin Society.
facts.ended_how: replaced: the goblins accepted a renegotiated deal to wall off the stairs and hold the upper rooms instead (fact_new_2)

facts.text: A huge undead with a greatsword in the Barrow Mound stands in the way (see thread_4).
facts.ended_how: no longer relevant: the deal no longer requires clearing the mound, and Sir Alfred was left incapacitated

facts.text: Wayman promised Snurk of the Free Goblin Society that he will never tell King Hogboon where the goblins are.

The Free Goblin Society (Watak, Grimble, Snurk and Peg) has agreed to wall off the Barrow Mound's stairs and hold its church, antechamber and statue room, and means to destroy the church there; they are friendly to the party and hiding from King Hogboon.
